text:
I have successfully fixed the bug where overlapping meeting blocks (specifically nested or out-of-order intervals) were not combined correctly. 

### Summary of Changes:
- Updated `merge_intervals` in `scheduler.py` to use `max(merged[-1][1], end)` when merging overlapping intervals, ensuring that the end time of the merged interval correctly spans the maximum end time of any overlapping or nested intervals, rather than blindly overwriting it with the current interval's end time.
